value.rationale: Random intersection of free chain-ring submodules is natural in module/coding theory, and intersections need not be free. A complete free-versus-torsion Smith profile and nontrivial critical-window law quantify a phenomenon absent over fields. The result covers every residue prime power and both equal- and mixed-characteristic length-two rings; balanced q=2 has nonzero torsion-only limiting probability about 0.33865.
